hooks.command: sh -c 'for v in "$(command -v vx 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.local/bin/vx" /opt/homebrew/bin/vx /usr/local/bin/vx /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/vx; do [ -f "$v" ] && [ -x "$v" ] && exec "$v" sentinel await; done; echo "vx: not found, so the sentinel Stop hook cannot wake the commander. Install vx (brew or curl) or put its directory on PATH, then run: vx doctor" >&2; exit 0'
